## What he does

Performance marketing (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok), SEO, web development
(Next.js, React), mobile development (Flutter), AI integration, data analytics
and tracking (GA4, GTM), and digital strategy. The through-line is that the same
person sets the strategy, builds the platform and runs the campaigns on it,
rather than handing off between three teams.

## Track record

- Emotion Group · Motion Motors — Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (May 2026 – present).
  Digital product and growth lead. Directed the Motion Motors website build and
  the Emotion Group growth plan; built the Motion Motors x SOUEAST campaign
  approach for the ANB finance offers; set the new-media and social strategy for
  SOUEAST in the Western Region; ran paid across Google, Meta and TikTok on GA4
  and GTM.
- Elite Marketing Services — Doha, Qatar (Aug 2025 – Mar 2026). Digital
  marketing for a multi-industry client portfolio across MENA.
- Omnis Media Group — MENA (Aug 2025 – Mar 2026). Digital strategy consultant
  for the organiser of Mobile Developers Week, held at Abu Dhabi Energy Center
  with 3,000+ attendees and 60+ global speakers.
- Ezz Al-Afaq Company (Jan 2024 – Jul 2025). Campaigns, web design and SEO
  across hospitality, healthcare and F&B accounts.
- Finance & Business Magazine — UAE (2024 – Feb 2025). Built and ran the digital
  presence of an editorial platform for business leaders.
- Binghatti Investments — Dubai (Dec 2022 – Aug 2023). SEO for one of Dubai's
  leading luxury real estate developers.
- Freelance (2020 – present). Digital work across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE
  and Oman, spanning healthcare, real estate, hospitality, legal, e-commerce
  and F&B.

Brands worked with include Ooredoo, QNB, Amazon Egypt, Saudi Arabian Airlines,
BinGhatti, Dunkin' and Geely.
